title: 05 — Platform
tagline: Everything around the features: dev tooling, diagnostics, testing, release pipeline, notifications and deep links, profiling.
intro: Everything around the features: dev tooling, diagnostics, testing, release pipeline, notifications and deep links, profiling.
Dev setup and the current CI workflow describe existing tooling. Diagnostics, release automation, push, and profiling sections define target work unless they say otherwise.

blocks.html:
• XcodeGen: a tool that creates the Xcode project from project.yml; edit the YAML source, then regenerate the project.
  • CI: automated checks that run on a server when code changes. Example: CI builds the app and runs lint.
  • SwiftLint / swift-format: tools that report style issues / format Swift code consistently.
  • Coverage: the share of executable code reached by tests; high coverage alone does not prove a feature works.
  • TestFlight: Apple's service for distributing pre-release app builds to testers.

1. First-time setup

StepAction
1Xcode with an iPhone simulator; brew install xcodegen xcode-build-server swiftlint xcbeautify
2Optional, hot reload: InjectionNext in /Applications (§5)
3xcodegen generate
4Open the repo root in VS Code; install the recommended extensions (.vscode/extensions.json)
5Build once (Xcode ⌘B or F5) → Command Palette → SweetPad: Generate Build Server Config → Swift: Restart LSP Server
6Run and Debug → Run SiteLog (simulator) → F5
  • Nothing in the committed .vscode/ is tied to one Mac.
  • buildServer.json and .vscode/sitelog.local.json are per machine and git-ignored.

2. XcodeGen

  • Why: D08.
  • SiteLog.xcodeproj is generated from project.yml; never edit the .pbxproj by hand.
WhenAction
After changing project.ymlxcodegen
After pulling a project.yml changexcodegen
Adding, removing, renaming files (Xcode, VS Code, Finder, git)Nothing: SiteLog/, SiteLogTests/, SiteLogUITests/ are synced folders; Packages/* are SwiftPM packages, which pick up files on their own
Adding an empty folder with a .gitkeepxcodegen, so the .gitkeep stays out of the build
After deleting a .gitkeepNothing now; the next xcodegen drops it from project.pbxproj, commit that
  • Close the project in Xcode before regenerating, or Xcode keeps the old one in memory.
  • The generated .xcodeproj stays committed, so the repo opens without running XcodeGen first.
  • Synced folders: Xcode reads the folders from disk, so project.pbxproj lists no files and only changes with project.yml. Every file in a folder belongs to that folder's target.
project.yml ownsKey
Team, versions, Swift 6 concurrency flagssettings.base
Local packages (DesignSystem, Core, DomainLayer, DataLayer, PlatformKit) and current remote ones (Factory, Inject); planned dependencies are recorded in the relevant decisionpackages
Which products each target linkstargets.<name>.dependencies
App target, bundle id, iOS 18.6 minimum deployment targettargets.SiteLog
SwiftLint build phasetargets.SiteLog.postBuildScripts
Hot reload flags, Debug onlytargets.SiteLog.settings.configs.Debug
Shared SiteLog scheme, INJECTION_PROJECT_ROOTschemes.SiteLog

3. SwiftLint and swift-format

ToolOwnsConfig
swift-formatFormatting: layout, line length, import order.swift-format
SwiftLintCorrectness and style rules that don't fight the formatter.swiftlint.yml

SwiftLint build phase (SiteLog → Build Phases → Run SwiftLint, after Resources):

ConditionBehavior
Apple SiliconPrepends /opt/homebrew/bin to PATH
swiftlint foundRuns from the repo root; issues show as Xcode warnings
swiftlint missingBuild warning brew install swiftlint; build continues
ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = NO (target only)Lets SwiftLint read the repo; with sandboxing on: Sandbox: swiftlint deny file-read-data
.swiftlint.ymlValues
excluded.build, DerivedData, build, each Packages/<Name>/.build
disabled_rulestrailing_whitespace, line_length, trailing_comma (owned by swift-format)
opt_in_rulesempty_count, explicit_init, redundant_type_annotation, unneeded_parentheses_in_closure_argument
.swift-format keyValueWhy
lineLength100Shared limit; SwiftLint's line_length is off
indentation.spaces4Xcode default
respectsExistingLineBreakstrueSwiftUI modifier chains stay multi-line
lineBreakBeforeEachArgumenttrueFits on one line → one line; otherwise one argument per line, ) on its own line
prioritizeKeepingFunctionOutputTogethertrueWraps the arguments, keeps ) -> T { on one line (SwiftLint opening_brace)
multiElementCollectionTrailingCommastrueCleaner diffs
OrderedImportsonImports sorted
  • Run manually: swiftlint.
  • Regenerate format defaults: swift format dump-configuration > .swift-format.

4. Format on save in Xcode

  • A Hammerspoon ⌘S hotkey, active only while Xcode is frontmost: Editor → Structure → Format File with ‘swift-format’, then File → Save 0.25 s later.
StepAction
1brew install --cask hammerspoon; grant Accessibility on first launch
2cp Tools/Hammerspoon/init.lua ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua
3Hammerspoon menu-bar icon → Reload Config; enable Launch at Login
4Menu item name check: focus a .swift file, press ⌘⌥D, open Hammerspoon Console, copy the Format File with ‘swift-format’ string; if it differs from Tools/Hammerspoon/init.lua, paste it into selectMenuItem
Global in init.luaRole
xcodeSave⌘S: format, then save
xcodeDebug⌘⌥D: prints every Editor → Structure item to the Console
xcodeWatcherEnables xcodeSave only while Xcode is active
SymptomFix
⌘S does nothing after reloading configXcode was already frontmost; switch away and back
selectMenuItem fails in the ConsoleConsole is frontmost, not Xcode; test via the hotkey
Format item not found after an Xcode update⌘⌥D again; update the string (curly quotes U+2018/U+2019)

Project setting (done)Value

SymptomFix

No hot reload from VS Code (F5)Debug Console should show 🔥 Platform connected; else see .vscode/sitelog_sim.py (ensure_injection_next)

6. Code snippets

ShortcutInsertsFile
viewSwiftUI view with Inject hot reload<Name>Screen.swift (any view)
viewvm@Observable view model (State enum, onAppear())<Screen>ViewModel.swift
struct / class / enum / protocolType named after the file (final class)Any
  • VS Code: .vscode/swift.code-snippets, in the repo.
  • Xcode: user snippets live in ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/UserData/CodeSnippets/, per machine. New machine: Library (⇧⌘L) → {} → select the code → right-click → Create Code Snippet, completion view / viewvm, availability Top Level.
  • Use: new empty file → type the shortcut → Return → Tab between placeholders; ⌃⌘E renames all uses.
  • Type named after the file:
    • VS Code: type struct (or public struct) → first suggestion → name = file name.
    • Xcode: snippets cannot read the file name, so use the file templates in Tools/Xcode/Templates/SiteLog/. Install once: cp -R Tools/Xcode/Templates/SiteLog ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Templates/File\ Templates/, restart Xcode. Use: ⌘N → section SiteLog → Struct / Class / Enum / Protocol → type the file name.

7. VS Code

FilePurpose
.vscode/settings.jsonswift-format on save, snippets first in suggestions, 100-column ruler, SweetPad scheme, xcodegen autogenerate off (synced folders), Debug Console in expression mode
.vscode/launch.jsonRun SiteLog (simulator) (CodeLLDB): build, run, Restart rebuilds, Stop kills the app
.vscode/sitelog_sim.pyIn LLDB: build, install, simctl launch --wait-for-debugger, attach by pid, stream app logs
.vscode/tasks.jsonsitelog: build: manual build with full output (F5 does not use it)
.vscode/swift.code-snippetsview / viewvm / struct / class / enum / protocol
TaskHow
Run with debuggerF5; Restart = fresh build and launch; ⇧F5 kills the app
Run without debuggerSweetPad sidebar → Build & Run
App logsDebug Console: every AppLogger line plus stdout/stderr
Debug Console inputSwift expression directly (self.title); LLDB commands with /cmd (/cmd bt)
Hot reloadSave; F5 starts InjectionNext if needed; Console shows 🔥 Recompiling → ✅ Hot reload complete
New fileCreate in the explorer; Xcode and the build pick it up (synced folder)

Simulator choice (F5), in order:

  1. SITELOG_SIMULATOR env var, or .vscode/sitelog.local.json: { "simulator": "iPhone 17 Pro Max" }.
  2. A booted iPhone simulator, else the iPhone on the newest iOS (booted on demand).

F5 opens the Debug Console at once (optional, user keybindings — VS Code has no per-workspace keybindings): Command Palette → Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts (JSON):

jsonc
{
  "key": "f5",
  "command": "runCommands",
  "args": { "commands": ["workbench.debug.action.focusRepl", "workbench.action.debug.start"] },
  "when": "!inDebugMode"
}

8. Rules for working in both editors

RuleWhy
Build in one editor at a timeBoth write the same DerivedData; parallel builds lock its database
Config changes go through project.ymlxcodegen overwrites the Xcode UI
After xcodegen, let Xcode reload (Revert)Reads the new project.pbxproj from disk
Previews, Instruments, signing: XcodeNo VS Code equivalent
Both editors format with .swift-formatXcode via Hammerspoon (§4)

9. Troubleshooting

SymptomFix
Xcode stuck: stale index, package resolution loops, odd build errorsmake reset-xcode (DerivedData, build/, package caches, regenerate, reopen); make deep-reset-xcode also clears the global SwiftPM cache
"No such module" / no completion in VS CodeBuild once, regenerate build server config, restart LSP
New file not visible in XcodeIt must sit inside SiteLog/, SiteLogTests/ or SiteLogUITests/
Multiple commands produce … .gitkeepA new .gitkeep is not excluded yet: xcodegen generate
No app logs in the Debug ConsoleCheck for sitelog_launch failed; logs come only from AppLogger (subsystem app.dd.site.log)
Build failed / sitelog_launch failedLines above say why (compiler error, unknown simulator name, install error)
install timed outAn older SiteLog is held by another debugger session; stop it, F5
SweetPad picks the wrong scheme.vscode/settings.json → sweetpad.build.scheme
Why not SweetPad's attachIts Restart started the binary outside the simulator (EXC_BREAKPOINT in BKSDisplayServicesStart); pid-by-name raced the relaunch. simctl launch + attach by pid avoids both

blocks.html:
• Module: SiteLog/Presentation/Diagnostics

Goal: users answer "where are my photos?" themselves; one exported file is enough for a developer to diagnose; cleanup can never delete anything not yet uploaded.

09.1 Upload status screen

Session 05 Sep — Ánh Dương Tower
████████████░░░░  187/243 files · 1.8 GB / 2.4 GB · ~6 min remaining
⚠ 4 waiting: Waiting for WiFi (3) · Waiting for a new upload link (1)
✕ 2 failed — [Retry]
  • Waiting is never red — waitingForNetwork and waitingForURL are normal.
  • Plain-language reasons, never enum names; "Will upload when the device is idle" when the OS holds tasks; estimates from the trailing throughputWindow.
  • A closed realtime channel is not an error, only slower.

09.2 Integrity checks and cleanup

CheckDetects
Record with no file / file with no recordLost media / orphan from a crash
Recomputed hash ≠ sha256 (originals only)Corruption or substitution
Audit chain HMACTampered log
Temp part with no job; uploading with no taskGarbage; stuck job → reset to pending
Derived image with no sourceStale stamped copy
  • Default: random sample of integritySampleSize; background "verify everything" on demand.

Cleanup

  • Only synced files are eligible, even with a full disk.
  • Numbers first: "Delete 156 uploaded files, freeing 1.4 GB. 12 not yet uploaded will be kept."
  • Temp parts, prebuffer, tiles, derived images: a separate "reclaimable" line.
  • Every cleanup writes an audit entry.

09.3 Diagnostic bundle and status flags

  • diagnostic-<date>.zip: device.json, permissions.json, upload-state.json (no URLs), integrity.json, logs.ndjson (24 h).
  • Redact on write: strip URLs, tokens, emails, user text, GPS; keep ids, enums, counters, status codes.
Red flagCondition
PermissionCamera, mic, location or Bluetooth denied
DiskFree space below minFreeDiskBytes
Thermal.serious or worse
BatteryBelow lowBatteryThreshold with pending uploads
NetworkOffline with pending jobs
AuditChain verification failed
SyncMetadata sync older than staleSyncThreshold

09.4 App-wide logging

  • os.Logger, subsystem app.dd.site.log, category per module (capture, upload, report, plans, devicelink, sync, security).
  • Every action logs with data, successes included; every catch logs String(reflecting:); no print (CI greps for it).
  • Firebase Crashlytics initializes first; non-fatals via Crashlytics.crashlytics().record(error:) with the same structured data (D07).
swift
enum DiagnosticsConstants {
    static let throughputWindow: TimeInterval = 60
    static let integritySampleSize: Int = 50
    static let logRetentionHours: Int = 24
    static let staleSyncThreshold: TimeInterval = 86_400
    static let lowBatteryThreshold: Float = 0.20
}

Done

  • All seven integrity conditions detected
  • The bundle has no URL, token, email, text or coordinate
  • Cleanup with 12 pending files deletes none of them

Tests

  • Detectors on a fake filesystem
  • Cleanup never touches pending/failed
  • Redacted bundle equals the expected text
  • Estimates never NaN or negative
  • Flags at 7 boundaries
  • uploading without task resets

blocks.html:
• Libraries and why: D06.
  • Per-feature test lists live in each spec's Tests block; this section sets the rules.
LayerTargetToolWhat
DomainPackages/DomainLayer/Tests/DomainLayerTestsSwift TestingPlanned: use cases and pure domain services; no device, no frameworks
CorePackages/Core/Tests/CoreTestsSwift TestingClock, logger helpers
DataPackages/DataLayer/Tests/DataLayerTestsSwift TestingPlanned: mappers and repository implementations
Data sourcesPackages/DataLayer/Tests/DataLayerTests/DataSources/<Name>Swift TestingPlanned: persistence and Keychain data sources
PlatformKitPackages/PlatformKit/Tests/PlatformKitTests/<Name>Swift TestingPlanned: upload state machine, realtime decoding, report layout, Bluetooth parsing
DesignSystemPackages/DesignSystem/TestsSwift TestingTokens (hex decoding)
PresentationSiteLogTests/PresentationSwift TestingPlanned: view models built on test doubles in SiteLogTests/Doubles/ through init, no container
ScreensSiteLogTests/Snapshotsswift-snapshot-testingOptional, last (F16 step 10): each screen light, dark, accessibility3
FlowsSiteLogUITestsXCUITestPlanned: smoke paths only, unlock → projects → capture → report
BackendBackend/testvitestSee 03-backend §12

Rules

  1. Scoped: a change runs the tests of the folder it touched plus DomainLayer (-only-testing:), not the full suite.
  2. No real network, clock, camera or Bluetooth in unit tests; inject AppClock, UploadTransport, CaptureSessionControlling, RandomNumberGenerator.
  3. View model tests pass test doubles through init; a test that overrides a Factory registration runs inside @Suite(.container), so it never leaks.
  4. A bug fix lands with the test that would have caught it.
  5. Snapshot tests are optional and come last (F16 step 10). If added, references are recorded on one pinned simulator (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.4) and re-recorded only in a commit that says why.

blocks.html:
• Modules: SiteLog/Presentation/Notifications, SiteLog/Presentation/DeepLinks

Goal: a notification tap or a sitelog:// URL opens the exact session or issue through one shared DeepLink type; a link during cold launch is not lost.

  • Out: rich notifications, universal links, silent push as an upload trigger.

  • Format sitelog://<route>/<id> (session/42, issue/7); wrong scheme, unknown route or missing id is ignored and logged. The parser is pure; ids are opaque data.

  • Payload { "aps": { "alert": {…} }, "deepLink": "sitelog://issue/42" } carries a destination only; state comes from the local store.

  • Authorization is requested at a moment that makes sense, not blindly at first launch; the token is logged truncated, replaceable, and re-sent when it changes.

  • Routing: URL / push → parser → router (pending) → tab + <Feature>Route pushed on that tab’s NavigationCoordinator (D19). The router holds the destination until a view consumes it (cold launch), consuming clears it, and a deleted target lands on a safe screen.

  • Setup: Push capability, aps-environment, sitelog URL scheme and remote-notification background mode in project.yml. Simulator: xcrun simctl push booted app.dd.site.log payload.json, xcrun simctl openurl booted sitelog://session/42.

Risks

  • Crafted ids from other apps are data, re-checked at the destination
  • Pushes for another account are ignored
  • The app works fully with push denied

Done

  • Links open from Safari and simctl
  • A tap opens the target when killed, backgrounded or foregrounded
  • Garbage is ignored without a crash

Tests

  • Parser routes and rejections
  • Payload with/without deepLink
  • Router holds until consumed
  • Cold-launch link survives (UI test)

• Tooling only; signposts live next to the code they measure.

Goal: know the real cost of the upload queue, the socket and capture before testers do; every performance claim has a measurement behind it. Always a real device, Release build.

QuestionTemplate
Slow or jankyTime Profiler
Memory growth, retain cyclesAllocations, Leaks
A SwiftUI view re-renders too oftenSwiftUI
Slow or duplicated requestsNetwork
Battery cost of socket / uploadEnergy Log
Time inside our own codeos_signpost / Points of Interest
  • Signposts: subsystem app.dd.site.log; intervals Connection/Message (Realtime), UploadPart/Reconcile (Upload), Capture/HashFile/Thumbnail (Capture).
  • Signpost metadata: sizes and counts only; they stay in Release.
#ScenarioBudget
1Queue 243 filesFlat memory, no growth linear in file count
230-minute uploadNo "High" energy impact in the foreground
3Socket open 10 minutesMessage in microseconds; no wake-ups beyond ping
4Burst of 20 photosNo dropped frames
5Session with 243 rowsNo re-renders on unrelated updates
  • Profile before optimizing; justify a change with a before/after trace.
  • Save traces for failed budgets; record device and OS with every result.
  • Scenarios run on device before each TestFlight build.
